assessment: Ticketed guided tour of Palacio Salvo with a viewpoint, terrace, stained glass and Tango Museum. Its route and tickets are independent of the mixed-use building.

observations.receptionHours: Monday–Friday 10:00–17:00, Saturday 10:00–14:00, Sunday 12:00–16:00 according to the tourism page.
observations.visitFormat: Guided timed departures in Spanish, English and Portuguese; about 45 minutes. Booking via RedTickets.
observations.route: Several floors, stained glass, terrace, floor-25 viewpoint and Tango Museum per November 2026 ticket listing.
observations.access: Stairs on route; terrace omitted when weather prevents access.
observations.price: Paid, but no publicly visible numeric current price on booking page; dynamic price with no fabricated minimum.
observations.youngChildren: Children five and younger free per the November ticket listing.

photos.depicts: building in Montevideo skyline at sunset

scopeNotes: November 2026 live departure list proves operation; future dates must be checked on the ticketing site.
Structured opening hours describe reception windows, not a continuous walk-in tour.
No numeric adult price is published in the accessible ticket listing; no price has been invented.
The exterior and aerial photos are not claimed to be taken during the tour.
